name: Rethban Ore
summary: Foreman Oslow sends you into Rethban Caverns in Redridge for a dark mineral the scribes of Northshire Abbey need for ink. It is too soft for strong weapons or armor, but its color makes it useful for their work.

sections.title: A Curious Mineral
sections.body: Scribes at Northshire Abbey prize Rethban Ore for its dark, flat color. Bart Rethban discovered the mineral, but it has little use at an armorer’s anvil. Smelted metal from the ore lacks the strength needed for sturdy weapons or plate. Its raw color instead makes a valued base for manuscript dyes.

sections.title: Contested Caverns
sections.body: The main deposits lie in the northern mountains of Redridge, inside Rethban Caverns. Lakeshire’s stoneworkers have left the cavern, driven out by a fierce band of Redridge gnolls. The gnolls put drudgers to work chipping ore from the rocky veins for their own crude purposes.

sections.title: Preserving the Word
sections.body: Brother Paxton, a monk at Northshire Abbey, needs the pigment to copy historic texts. His work on The Stresses of Iron has stopped without the proper dye. Messengers and adventurers now travel into gnoll-held territory to bring him the raw stone.

faq.q: What is Rethban Ore used for?
aliases: why do we need rethban ore
faq.answer: Smelted Rethban Ore is too weak for durable weapons or armor, but its dark, flat color makes a useful base for inks and dyes. Brother Paxton and other scribes at Northshire Abbey use it to copy historic manuscripts.
Bart Rethban was the explorer and prospector who discovered the dark ore veins in the northern mountains of Redridge. The mineral and the Rethban Caverns take their name from him.

faq.q: Why hasn't Lakeshire mined the ore recently?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow and Lakeshire’s workers are occupied defending the town from Blackrock orc incursions. Redridge gnolls have also taken over Rethban Caverns and driven out the civilian miners.

faq.q: What book is Brother Paxton copying?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton is copying The Stresses of Iron. He needs the dark dye made from Rethban Ore to finish the text for the abbey’s library.

faq.q: Why do gnolls want the ore?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls have their drudgers dig throughout the caverns. They may want the ore for crude implements, trade, or to fortify their mountain warrens against intruders.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
aliases: what quest comes after rethban ore
faq.answer: After Brother Paxton receives the ore and prepares his inks, he sends you back to Stormwind to report your success to Kristoff, completing the errand for Northshire’s scribes.

angles.text: As a miner, you can take Rethban Ore from cavern veins with a pick instead of scavenging raw chunks from gnoll drudgers.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see how stretched the Kingdom of Stormwind’s supply lines are: monastery scribes rely on travelers to fetch writing supplies from war zones.
As a human, you share the duty of Stormwind’s scholars to preserve Northshire Abbey’s manuscripts and restore knowledge lost during the First and Second Wars.
